definitions.gloss: sharing an umbrella (of two people, especially a couple)
definitions.explanation: Two people walking together under one umbrella, a classic romantic image; also the doodle of an umbrella with two names written under it, a sign that the two are (or should be) a couple.

examples.japanese: {相合傘|あいあいがさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: To walk home sharing an umbrella.

examples.japanese: ⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{相合傘|あいあいがさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}かれていた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Someone had drawn a lovers' umbrella on the blackboard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{相合傘|あいあいがさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: It started to rain, so he and I walked to the station under one umbrella.

notes:
Also written {相|あい}{合|あ}い{傘|がさ}. The doodle (a triangle-topped umbrella with a name on each side of the handle) is a schoolchild's tease, like carving initials in a heart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相合傘|あいあいがさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to share an umbrella
- {相合傘|あいあいがさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk under one umbrella
